versions.name: Public Speaking
versions.description: Introduce yourself to a live audience, deliver a prepared talk with visual aids and an impromptu one with no warning, research and write a longer speech, and run a meeting by the rules of order.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
